name: Hand Crank Wooden Music Box
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality 5mm wood, offering a warm, classic, and elegant handcrafted look.
    - Features a sturdy wooden box construction with smooth edges and a refined decorative finish.
    - Equipped with a hand crank movement that plays music without the need for batteries.
    - The fixed melody is “You Are My Sunshine”, creating a sweet and meaningful listening experience.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size:
                 +) Length: 2.5 in ~ 6.35 cm
                 +) Width: 2.1 in ~ 5.33 cm
                 +) Height: 1.71 in ~ 4.34 cm
    📌 Note: The shape is fixed and cannot be changed. Customers may customise only the printed design.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    - 2-sided printing is applied on the wooden box for a polished and decorative appearance.

 

  • How to Use:
    - Step 1: Hold the music box steadily in your hand or place it on a flat surface.
    - Step 2: Turn the hand crank clockwise to play the melody.
    - Step 3: Adjust the cranking speed to make the melody play faster or slower. Continuously for a smoother and - clearer sound.

        📌 Note: This product plays music manually, does not require batteries, and the fixed song is “You Are My Sunshine.”

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as both a musical keepsake box and a decorative collectible.
    - Hand crank mechanism allows the music to play smoothly without batteries.
    - Compact and lightweight, making it easy to hold, carry, and display.
    - Suitable for placing on desks, shelves, bedside tables, or memory corners.
    - Perfect for creating a sentimental and nostalgic gift experience.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for birthdays, anniversaries, Valentine’s Day, Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for memorial gifts, romantic keepsakes, and heartfelt surprise presents.
    - A thoughtful gift for music lovers and anyone who enjoys classic handcrafted items.
    - Great for holiday gifting, custom message gifts, and treasured memory collections.
    - Adds a warm, personal, and charming touch to every special moment 🎁 

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x  Hand Crank Wooden Music Box

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
